_comment: Pyright error backlog. CI fails if the count rises above this, so new code must be clean while the backlog is paid down separately. Measured in a CI-equivalent environment (Python 3.11, only the [dev] extras installed, no ComfyUI venv on ../..) — a local run with torch present reports a different number, so do not regenerate this from a dev machine. Regenerate with: python scripts/check_pyright_baseline.py --update
